clauses.title: Scope – Covers the
clauses.text: 1 Scope - Covers the nominal dimensions, mass and sectional properties of hot rolled parallel flange beams, columns and bearing piles.

clauses.title: Beams, column and pile
clauses.text: 2.1  Beams, column and pile sections are classified as follows. a) Indian Standard Narrow Parallel Flange Beams, NPB. b) Indian Standard Wide Parallel Flange Beams, WPB. c) Indian Standard Parallel Flange Bearing Piles, PBP.

clauses.title: The following abbreviated reference symbols have
clauses.text: 2.3 The following abbreviated reference symbols have been used in designating the Indian Standard sections mentioned in 2.1: Sl.No. Section Classification Abbreviated Reference Symbol (1) (2) (3) (4) i) Beams ISNPB NPB ii) Beams/Columns ISWPB WPB iii) Pile Sections ISPBP PBP For detailed information, refer to IS 12778 : 2004  Specifications for  hot rolled steel sections for parallel flange beams, columns - dimensions and section properties and bearing piles (first revision).

clauses.title: Nominal dimensions and mass
clauses.text: 3.1 Nominal dimensions and mass of narrow and wide parallel flange beams and bearing piles shall conform to the values given in Tables 1 to 3, respectively of the standard.

clauses.title: Dimensional and mass tolerances
clauses.text: 3.2 Dimensional and mass tolerances of the various sections shall conform to the appropriate values stipulated in IS 12779*.

clauses.title: Sectional Properties
clauses.text: 4  Sectional Properties Sectional properties of the beam, column and pile sections are given in Tables 1 to 3 of the standard, for information. * Rolling and cutting tolerances for hot rolled parallel flange beam and column sections - specification.
